items.a: We help businesses win online through five connected services: custom business website design and development, CMS builds on WordPress, Webflow or headless platforms, PPC landing pages for Google and Meta Ads, SEO and AEO, and redesigns for websites that have lost their spark. Strategy, design, build and growth – all under one roof.

items.q: How much does a business website cost?
items.a: It depends on what your website needs to do. Page count, design depth, your choice of CMS, integrations like booking or e-commerce, and content all shape the price – a focused landing page costs far less than a full multi-page site. After a free 30-minute strategy call, you get a fixed, itemised quote with no surprises.

items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a: Most business websites go from kickoff to launch in 3–6 weeks. A single PPC landing page can be live in 1–2 weeks, while larger CMS or e-commerce builds take a little longer. You get a clear, week-by-week timeline after our first call, and you see progress at every stage.

items.q: What is a CMS and do I need one?
items.a: A CMS (Content Management System) such as WordPress or Webflow lets you edit pages, blogs and images yourself – no code, no waiting on a developer. If your website will grow and change, you need one. We pick the right platform for your goals, build it, and train your team to use it.

items.q: Should I choose WordPress or Webflow for my business website?
items.a: Choose WordPress for a vast plugin library, WooCommerce e-commerce or full control over hosting. Choose Webflow for design freedom, built-in hosting and an editor non-technical teams love. For high-traffic or multi-channel brands, a headless CMS like Sanity or Strapi paired with Next.js often wins. We'll recommend what truly fits.

items.q: How are PPC landing pages different from a normal website?
items.a: A PPC landing page has one job: turning paid clicks from Google Ads or Meta Ads into leads or sales. It strips away menus and distractions, echoes the exact promise of your ad and loads in under two seconds – which lifts your Quality Score and lowers your cost per lead.

items.q: What is AEO and how is it different from SEO?
items.a: SEO (Search Engine Optimisation) helps your website rank in Google search results. AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) shapes your content, FAQs and structured data so AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews can understand, quote and recommend your brand. The two work best together – and we do both.

items.q: How long does SEO take to show results?
items.a: Most websites see early SEO movement within 3 months and meaningful traffic growth within 6, depending on competition, site history and content. Our clients average 3X organic traffic growth within six months of launch, and monthly reports show you exactly which pages and keywords are climbing.

items.q: Will a website redesign hurt my Google rankings?
items.a: Not when it is done with care. Before any redesign we map every existing URL, protect or improve your best-ranking content, set up 301 redirects and watch Google Search Console after launch. Most post-redesign ranking drops come from missing redirects or deleted content – our migration process prevents both.

items.q: Do I own my website after it is built?
items.a: Completely. Your domain, design, content and CMS accounts belong to you. We hand over every login at launch, train your team to run the site, and never lock you into proprietary systems or contracts you can't walk away from.

items.q: Do you work with clients in other countries?
items.a: Yes – we work with brands in more than 35 countries. Every project runs remotely, with Google Meet calls booked in your local time zone, a shared project timeline and one dedicated point of contact from kickoff to launch.

items.q: Do you provide support after launch?
items.a: Launch is where the real work begins. We offer website maintenance, hosting guidance, security and plugin updates, backups and monthly SEO and performance reports – so your website stays fast, secure and keeps climbing.
